# mtncloud_form (Data Source)

Looks up one form by ID or by name, including one made in the console. Forms collect inputs for workflows and catalog orders. A name must match exactly one form.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By name (matched exactly); `id = 123` works too.
data "mtncloud_form" "example" {
  name = "Request a VM"
}

output "form_code" {
  value = data.mtncloud_form.example.code
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the form. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the form, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) Form code.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `labels` (List of String) Labels.
